title: Panchayat
right: Right to Say No to Child Marriage
tagline: Pooja wants to study, but a wedding is being planned.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Pooja is 15. She just topped her class in the Class 9 exams.

nodes.speaker: papa
nodes.text: Pooja, we have found a good boy for you. The wedding will be after Diwali.

nodes.speaker: pooja
nodes.text: But Papa, I want to finish school and become a nurse!

nodes.speaker: papa
nodes.text: Everyone in our village marries young. It's decided.

nodes.speaker: sunny
nodes.text: Pooja, you're only 15! What will you do?

choices.label: Agree quietly. Papa has already decided.
Run away from home alone at night.
Tell Sunita Didi at the Anganwadi and call 1098.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Pooja leaves school. Her dream of becoming a nurse starts to fade.

nodes.speaker: mitthu
nodes.text: Pooja is 15, not 18. Is this wedding even allowed? Try again!

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Running away alone at night is very dangerous, and Pooja has nowhere safe to go.

nodes.speaker: mitthu
nodes.text: There's a safer way to get help. Try again!

nodes.speaker: pooja
nodes.text: Didi, my family is planning my wedding. I'm only 15.

nodes.speaker: sunita
nodes.text: You did the right thing, Pooja. A girl must be 18 and a boy must be 21 to marry. Anything earlier is a child marriage, and it's a crime.

nodes.speaker: sunita
nodes.text: Let's call 1098 together. The Child Marriage Prohibition Officer will talk to your family.

nodes.speaker: papa
nodes.text: We didn't know this was against the law. We only wanted the best for her.

nodes.speaker: sunita
nodes.text: The best thing for Pooja is to finish her studies. Let her fly!

nodes.speaker: pooja
nodes.text: Thank you, Papa! I'll make you proud.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Pooja asked for help, and the wedding was stopped. She's back in school, one step closer to becoming a nurse.

card.title: Right to Say No to Child Marriage
card.kid: Girls must be at least 18 and boys at least 21 to get married. If anyone plans a wedding for a child, it's against the law. You can say no and ask for help.
card.teen: Under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, anyone who performs, arranges or promotes a child marriage can be jailed for up to 2 years and fined up to ₹1 lakh. States appoint Child Marriage Prohibition Officers to stop these marriages. If a child marriage has already happened, the person who was married as a child can ask a court to cancel it, up to 2 years after becoming an adult.
card.ifItHappens: Call 1098, or tell a teacher, an Anganwadi worker or the Child Marriage Prohibition Officer.

questions.q: What is the minimum legal age of marriage for girls in India?
What is the minimum legal age of marriage for boys in India?
Which number can you call to stop a child marriage?
questions.explain: 1098 is Childline, free and open day and night.

questions.q: Both families agree to marry their 15-year-old children. Is it allowed?
options: No, it's still a child marriage
questions.explain: Family agreement doesn't matter. Below 18 for girls or 21 for boys is a child marriage.

questions.q: Which of these could be a sign that a child marriage is being planned?
options: A 14-year-old is suddenly taken out of school and wedding shopping begins
A cousin gets a new school bag
A family plans a birthday party
A student joins a sports team
questions.explain: Being pulled out of school with wedding plans is a big warning sign. Tell a trusted adult or call 1098.

questions.q: Which official is appointed to stop child marriages?
questions.explain: The Act asks states to appoint Child Marriage Prohibition Officers.

questions.q: Someone married as a child can ask a court to cancel the marriage until how long after becoming an adult?
questions.explain: A child marriage is voidable at the option of the person married as a child, within 2 years of reaching adulthood.
